zw.intro: What needs attention now — and which steps can stabilise your coalition.
zw.keineGefahr: The promises tracked here are no longer currently at risk. Other political developments can change that.
zw.erinnerung: Open reminder: respond by {datum}. If left unanswered, this promise is treated as broken.
zw.akut: The partner’s support is already below the break threshold. Act before the next monthly review.
zw.wenig: The partner has little loyalty to spare. A broken promise can push them below the break threshold.
zw.fristRisiko: This promise needs a timely response. Its due date alone does not trigger an immediate coalition exit.
zw.fraktionRisiko: This faction judges you by your promise. Willingness to cooperate and credibility are at stake.
zw.pruefung: Monthly review on {datum}: an active party leader below 20 loyalty causes the party to leave. You would lose {sitze} government seats, leaving {rest}. Other monthly effects also apply beforehand.
zw.verfall: If a reminder expires unanswered: up to −15 loyalty, leaving the weakest leader at {n} based on today’s state. This is conditional, not an extra deduction today.
zw.zuSpaet: The planned vote falls after the promise deadline or reaches the open reminder deadline. Address the deadline and support now; a bill alone fulfils nothing.
zw.knapp: Majority not secured: based on today’s state, {ja} yes votes are expected at the vote. 301 are needed; known support expiry dates are included.
zw.reihenfolge: Fulfil the promise and secure support: address both. Postponing extends the deadline but costs loyalty. A conversation does not fulfil the promise.
zw.opposition: This party is not another coalition partner. These actions concern its promise and cooperation; negotiate a new coalition in parliament.
zw.entwurf: Vote on {datum} · currently {ja} expected yes votes
zw.vertroesten: Gain time · at a political cost
zw.vertroestenText: The existing postponement moves the due date to 90 days from today. It costs 1 PC, loyalty and government trust; at most twice.
zw.einloesenText: The existing promise action delivers the commitment. Actual immediate costs and personal effects are shown below.
zw.gespraecheText: These existing conversations strengthen support immediately. The promise stays open; shared cooldowns also apply to other promises.
zw.erstVotum: Planned vote: {datum}. Only a sufficient decision earns the promise bonus. Any current coalition break risk remains until then.
zw.empfehlung.akut: Next step: strengthen support with a conversation and fulfil the promise separately. Check below which action actually reaches the break threshold.
zw.empfehlung.gesetz: Next step: check the bill and majority in parliament. If support is weak, also speak with the coalition partner.
zw.empfehlung.erfuellen: Next step: deliver the promised commitment. If that is not yet possible, check the loyalty cost of postponement.
zw.eigene: Your own faction expects the promised commitment. Fulfil the promise or review the cost of postponement; no coalition agreement with your own party is needed.
